headline: Gold Spot Prices Hold Steady Across Major Indian Metropolitan Markets
summary: Gold spot prices remained steady across key Indian cities including Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Chennai. Trading in 24-carat and 22-carat gold reflected stable demand following recent price consolidation.
why: India is the world's second-largest consumer of physical gold, where domestic bullion prices influence import volumes and trade deficits.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Flat spot prices across Indian consumer centers reflect steady retail physical purchasing.
